items.line: This decides the last League A quarter-final place in Group A4. Denmark (9 pts) go through if they avoid defeat. Norway (6 pts) must win in Copenhagen, where Haaland's two goals settled the 3-2 reverse fixture. The loser goes into the A/B play-offs, and the quarter-final draw is on Nov 20.

items.line: Tyrrell Hatton closed with a 66 to win the Dubai finale by five shots. Rory McIlroy finished solo second, which was enough for his eighth Race to Dubai title and ties Colin Montgomerie's record. McIlroy said he now wants 'double digits'.
